ALL INDIA • SUPPLY & DEMAND

All Items Suppliers & Buyers

Connect suppliers and buyers for groceries and all types of products/items — including city/local bazaar suppliers, large shopkeepers, warehouses, mills/factories, enterprises, firms, wholesalers, company/brand agencies and home customers.

REGISTRATION 01

Suppliers

Businesses supplying groceries and all types of products/items can register their details, location and supply category.

REGISTRATION 02

Wholesale Buyer / Retailers

Dual-purpose retailer profile: Retailers can purchase goods from Suppliers at wholesale rates and sell products to Retail / Domestic Buyers through their profile.

Supplier Access: Retailers can search and view registered Supplier profiles to purchase goods. Supplier privacy: Suppliers will not view or search Retailer profiles.

REGISTRATION 03

Domestic Buyers

Individuals and home customers can register mainly to find and purchase products for personal, household and domestic requirements from Retailers and Suppliers.

PROFILE DASHBOARD

Workers, Suppliers & Retailers Search

Search profiles in your local area using State → District → City → City Area. No name is required. Work requirements can search Workers, Retailers can search Suppliers, and Domestic Buyers can search Retailers.

📍 Find Nearby Profiles by Current Device Location

Address details select kiye bina apni current location use karke nearby Workers, Suppliers ya Retailers dekhiye. Location permission dene ke baad radius choose karein.

Current Location mode: address fields ki zarurat nahi. Browser/device Location permission allow karne par aapke current coordinates se radius ke andar registered profiles distance ke saath dikhenge. Manual Address mode: neeche State → District → Block → City → City Area / Locality manually bharna mandatory hai, especially unregistered searchers ke liye.
Current location browser/device permission se li jayegi. Profile distance KM me dikhaya jayega.

Search Workers

Select your location and Worker category/sub-category to find available Workers. Names are not required for searching.

Address search ke liye State, District, Block, City aur City Area / Locality manually enter karna required hai. Current Location search ke liye upar 📍 button use karein.
Enter State, District, Block, City and City Area / Locality, then tap Search.
